subject: general
question: P, Q and R can do a piece of work in 9 days, 18 days and 12 days, respectively. They start the work, with P working on Day 1, Q working on Day 2 and R working on Day 3, and then continuing with this cycle till the work got is completed. How many days will be needed to complete this work in this manner?
